acceptance_criteria: Official source evidence and year caveat recorded; complete checked source manifest and crosswalk if a compatible layer qualifies; no false link between Woodbridge and Potomac View; geometry, audit, R checks, and map review pass before local publication. Record unresolved 2026-27 source separately if the snapshot cannot represent it.
notes: 2026-10-25: Local validation complete. PWCS official locator web map labels elementary layer /1 2025-26; middle /2 and high /3 current. Staged 94 polygons (63 ES, 18 MS, 13 HS), checked manifest and 96-row explicit crosswalk, linked 93 of 95 schools. Excluded Porter and Pennington Traditional. Geometry report: all valid/nonempty; ES same-level overlap 165.79 m2 in small edge patches (reviewed cap 170), MS 0.65 m2, HS negligible; roughly 107.12 km2 HS-only main area near Quantico recorded without inferred assignment. Deterministic published local JSON SHA-256 d07a396fa4f233fb9116ad6e0b6d6caaa2383143249d58fdf27a612a82fec4f4. Statewide audit 881/1810 matched; R zone/snapshot checks and local app map review passed. 2026-27 Woodbridge change remains blocked in .6.3. See docs/ZONES_COVERAGE.md and inventory row 5103130. Public release remains .11.

Existing neighboring and Roanoke builders are references. Need generic staged importer with per-division manifest/crosswalk, paginated fetch, validation and atomic publish. Legacy build_zones_division_sources.R writes incompatible rings shape; do not run.
2026-10-25 progress: Added docs/ZONE_IMPORT_CONTRACT.md and tracked data-raw/zone_school_crosswalks/5100270.csv (29 mapped, 6 no-neighborhood-zone rows). Arlington builder now reads exact source-name/level to current school-ID crosswalk; no fuzzy publication match. Rebuild kept active GeoJSON SHA-256 054e5dea550d73225910d7d4b7f6e62308a7a2c25c8c0b1272038a47124bb95b. Deliberately bad crosswalk label and manifest hash both failed with active file unchanged. Arlington stager now calls returnIdsOnly and fetches checked object-ID pages, then verifies returned IDs; paged download also rebuilt same active hash. Next: generalize per-division spec/stager/builder, atomic stage writes, and reviewed overlap/gap report. R zone check passed before final no-op rebuild; git diff --check passed.
2026-10-25 completion: Shared per-division spec, checked ArcGIS object-ID paging and direct GeoJSON staging, content-hash raw files, atomic manifest, explicit complete crosswalk, WGS84 bounds, GDAL geometry repair, equal-area overlap/gap report, reviewed overlap limit, atomic active-file replacement, cache refresh, and audit gates implemented. Arlington generic dry run and publish reproduce existing SHA-256 054e5dea550d73225910d7d4b7f6e62308a7a2c25c8c0b1272038a47124bb95b. Tests cover bad hash/crosswalk/partial source preserving active file, multi-page and missing ID, direct GeoJSON fixture. audit_zones.py, check_zones.R, check_snapshot.R, Python compile, and git diff --check pass. Prior local map check covered level and selected-school behavior on same hash. Report records tiny overlap slivers and elementary gap; no invented coverage. Direct GeoJSON tested with fixture only; first real second-division source remains a later cohort task. Public deployment remains separate.
